validate_forward.rule: read ONCE on the weekly pulls, on the Head's go, by the survivors of the development read only (about 14 trading days)

rules.A_overnight: entry at the candle ending 16:00 ET, exit at the candle ending 09:31 ET of the next ET weekday (Friday entries exit Monday); class weekend (Friday entry) or weeknight (Monday to Thursday entry) x side long or short = 4 rules
rules.A2_gap: the OPENGAP entry at the candle ending 09:31 ET: g = (U_open/U_prev - 1) - (P_0925/P_prev1600 - 1), trigger |g| above 2 x the half spread fraction AND above a threshold of 40 or 100 bp; class Monday or Tuesday to Friday; mode follow or fade; exit T30, T60 or TC (the candle ending 16:00 ET) = 2 x 2 x 2 x 3 = 24 rules
rules.B1_open: open move over N minutes: m = mid(candle ending 09:31 + N) / mid(candle ending 09:31) - 1 for N = 5, 15, 30; fires when |m| is at least 20 or 40 bp; entry at the candle ending 09:31 + N; follow or fade; exit T30, T60 or TC = 3 x 2 x 2 x 3 = 36 rules
rules.B2_close: close move: m = mid(candle ending 15:30 ET) / mid(candle ending 15:00 ET) - 1; fires when |m| is at least 20 or 40 bp; entry at 15:30; follow or fade; exit at the candle ending 16:01 ET or at the next 09:31 ET (TO) = 2 x 2 x 2 = 8 rules
rules.B3_closedrift: unconditional: entry at the candle ending 15:30 ET, exit at the candle ending 16:01 ET, long or short = 2 rules
rules.C_funding: entry at the candle ending T - 60, 30 or 15 minutes, exit at the candle ending T + 15, 30 or 60 minutes, side long, short or the side that RECEIVES the print (short if the last rate is above 0, long if below, no trade at exactly 0); T = the name's own print timestamp of the day (the 4 PM ET print: 21:00Z in EST for the stocks) = 3 x 3 x 3 = 27 rules
rules.common: one position per name per rule at a time (the next entry needs e >= the previous exit end); DST aware ET clocks (the offset read at the ET day's midday: EDT 2026-03-08T07:00Z to 2026-11-01T06:00Z); boundary: no trade whose entry or exit end is at or after 2026-11-17T00:00Z in the development read; funding booked from the prints (long pays a positive rate), a trade without booked funding is out of the gates and counted; entry fills at the ask (long) or bid (short) times (1 +- h), exits at the bid or ask times (1 -+ h), h relative 0.0002 and 0.0005 primary, 0.001 and 0.002 stress counted apart

holds.status: OPEN (forward, read once on the Head's go)

look_ahead.A: entry candle ending 16:00 ET (uses nothing after it), exit candle ending 09:31 ET next weekday
look_ahead.A2: the gap uses the underlying's official open and previous close (known at 09:30 ET) and the perp candles ending at or before 09:31 ET; entry at the 09:31 candle
look_ahead.B1: m uses candles ending at or before the entry candle (09:31 + N); entry at that candle
look_ahead.B2: m uses the candles ending 15:00 and 15:30 ET; entry at 15:30
look_ahead.C: T is the name's own print timestamp of the day (a schedule fact: the previous print's time of day, read from timestamps and never from a rate); the receiving side uses the last rate strictly before the entry candle end
look_ahead.exit: every exit price is the leave quote of the candle ending at the exit instant, never an earlier or later candle
look_ahead.fill: entry at the quote of the entry candle

costs.fee_note: 12 and 5 bps a side both ASSUMED until Kalshi's published perps fee is read (Desk A); neither is the headline; $870 notional at 1x and a 2x line in messages only

gates.unit: pooled over all names; day clustered z and p (one-sided upper tail) of the 0.02% net; n and trade days counted pooled

tries.prior_m: from the TALLY (m_carried, the day's number) + 101

prediction: most rules fail (round trip 24 bp taker plus 8 bp haircuts against session moves of 10 to 40 bp); P(any rule clears the gates on development and holds on the forward read) about 3%; the weekend rules (A, class weekend) and the funding window C are the best chance
kill: no rule with n 100 or more pooled, 10 trade days and PF 1.3 at 0.02% with both halves 1.0 or more and PF 1.0 at 0.05%, or nothing survives BH; kill fast at PF under 1.0 at 0.02% on the first read
subset_rationale: the 101 cells were fixed from round numbers (windows of 15, 30 and 60 minutes, thresholds of 20, 40, 100 bp) and the Head's three topics before any figure of these rules was read; no cell was removed or added after a read
halves: floor(n/2) in entry order (entry end, ticker)
fee_form: perps: relative fee a side on the notional (12 and 5 bps), a haircut h relative to the fill price; binaries are not used; the standing ceil(round(0.07 x n x p x (1 - p) x 100, 9)) / 100 form and the void rule do not apply to perps (no settlement)
n_floor: no evidence at n = x below 100

outputs.survivor_line: rule, pooled n, trade days, PF at 0.02% and 0.05% for 12 and 5 bps, day clustered z, dollars at $870 notional (1x and 2x), margin terms at 10, 25 and 50 percent of the maximum with liquidation distance
